system.description:
The Ravnos projects her Chimerstry to any location she can see, visualize, has visited, or has a sufficiently detailed photo or description of, allowing her to work illusions far from her own body.

System: The Ravnos rolls Perception + Subterfuge; difficulty scales with her familiarity with the location (6 if as familiar as her own haven or currently viewed via Clairvoyance/Psychic Projection; 7 if visited three or more times; 8 if visited once or viewed via a live camera feed; 9 if only described in detail; 10 if never visited and known only from a photo or broadcast). Once successful, any other Chimerstry power may be used at that location for the remainder of the scene.

MET: Master Discipline. The Ravnos spends one Willpower Trait and wins a Static Mental Challenge (difficulty 10 Traits); this challenge is waived entirely if the location is within the character's line of sight via telescope or Auspex.
